result.rationale: The diff shows the Salesforce CalendarService constructor path now unconditionally performs a fetch to login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token and a prisma.credential.update (lines added at ~74-98 in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts) with no check of existing token validity, whereas before it simply created the jsforce.Connection from stored credentials. This adds a remote HTTP call and a database write to every service instantiation/calendar operation — a real, specific, substantive performance/architecture concern grounded directly in the added code, though not a correctness or security
